purpose: phase_5 was the only sub-100 cell with no itemised evidence record, while scripts/verify_project_progress_manifest.py only range-checks percentages. That combination meant any number written for phase_5 would have been accepted unchecked. This document names what the gap actually contains so the number can later move on evidence instead of judgement.

honest_limitation.note: No artifact in the repository records how 68 was computed. 65 of 71 markers are non-blocked, which is roughly 92 percent, so 68 is not a marker ratio. This document can therefore itemise WHAT is missing, but it cannot retro-derive the arithmetic that produced 68.
honest_limitation.consequence: Converting the blocks below into percentage points requires an explicit Owner weighting decision. Inventing a weighting here would repeat exactly the failure this document exists to prevent.

outstanding_blocks.title: GHCR publication and release promotion
outstanding_blocks.external_gate_status: ghcr_image_digest_verify is the single remaining entry in external-gate-summary.missing_or_failed_gates
outstanding_blocks.note: Owner-gated. Per decision E3 option (a) this is reclassified as a post-market step, so it must NOT hold phase_5 below 100 once the readiness definition is adopted. Executing it while docker_registry_publish sits in $expectedClosedGateIds (verify-market-ready.ps1:204-217) would drive MARKET_READY back to false.

outstanding_blocks.title: Release-candidate browser and sweep evidence bound to a retired hosting boundary
outstanding_blocks.why_blocked: These proofs were captured against the retired sslip.io / Hetzner bridge. scripts/verify-retired-hosted-boundary.ps1 pins them as Status: superseded with retired_boundary: sslip_io_hetzner, so the evidence exists but is bound to a surface that no longer exists.
outstanding_blocks.why_possibly_actionable: A current hosted surface does exist and already carries fresh browser evidence at dev_only=false, proof_scope=hosted_https (22/22 routes, 29/29 families, 161/161 actions). Re-executing these six release-candidate proofs against the current surface needs no Owner gate and no payment.
outstanding_blocks.required_before_claiming: Confirm the candidate release artifacts and the current hosted URLs still line up. Do not mark any of the six as verified without a fresh run bound to the current boundary. The superseded artifacts must not be relabelled.

rules: This document grants no percentage credit and moves no cell.
phase_5 may only rise when a named block above closes with its own evidence artifact.
Block B closing does not imply Block A closing, and vice versa. No combined or rounded-up credit.
The six superseded artifacts stay superseded. Re-binding old evidence to a new boundary would be evidence laundering, not verification.
